plugin.name: Data sources
plugin.description: PostgreSQL data sources: a direct connection, or through ssh to a container on a server. Queries run read-only.
setting.timeout.hint: A statement running longer is cancelled by the database.
field.password.hint: Written to the keychain, never to the data source itself.
field.importUrl.placeholder: postgres://user@host:5432/database or ssh://host/container?user=u&db=d — without the password
note.ssh: ssh uses ~/.ssh/config and never asks for a password; the server needs docker and the container needs psql.
message.imported: Connection string imported. Save to keep it.
message.importedPassword: Imported, without the password. Type it in the password field.
message.badUrl: This is not a connection string OneDesk understands.
error.badField: The setting “{field}” is empty or not allowed (letters, digits and . _ - @ : only; no leading -).
error.severalStatements: Only one statement can run at a time.
error.noSource: No data source: pick one on the statement, in the environment, or set the default.
error.backslash: A backslash outside a string, a quoted name or a comment is not allowed (it would be a psql command).
error.notRead: Only SELECT, WITH, VALUES, TABLE, EXPLAIN and SHOW statements can run here.
error.badTimeout: The timeout or row limit must be a positive whole number.
note.readonly: Statements run in a read-only transaction that is rolled back, one statement at a time. This does not stop what a database superuser can do on the server (COPY … TO PROGRAM, dblink): connect with a read-only account.
field.backupName.hint: Lower-case letters, digits and _ only. It must not exist yet: an existing database is never touched.
note.backup: Back up to this Mac: pg_dump on the server, the dump saved in the app's backup folder, copied into the local container, restored into a new database, and a direct data source made for it.
summary.backup: Restored into {name}. The dump ({size}) is saved in {file}.
error.backup.notSsh: Backing up to this Mac needs a data source reached over ssh.
error.backup.backupName: The new database name must be lower-case letters, digits and _ (starting with a letter or _), at most 63 characters.
error.backup.backupContainer: The local container must be a docker container name: letters, digits and _ . - only.
error.backup.backupPort: The local port must be a number from 1 to 65535.
error.backup.backupUser: The local user is empty or not allowed (letters, digits and . _ - @ : only; no leading -).
error.backup.noDocker: docker was not found on this Mac ({reason}). Install Docker Desktop, or put docker in /usr/local/bin or /opt/homebrew/bin.
error.backup.exists: The database “{name}” already exists in {container}. It is left as it is: choose another name.
